reason: This is a planner-core semantic change, not just a local cleanup: it touches plan construction (`expression_rewriter`, `logical_plan_builder`), optimizer entrypoints (`optimizer.go`, `logical_rules.go`), and adds a new elimination rule. Changing when/where empty `Selection` nodes disappear can alter logical plan shape and rule interactions across many query patterns, so it is central and risky enough for a focused Blocker/High review.
